note: Simple Block + Layout Builder integrates simple_block config blocks with Layout Builder. An event subscriber (SimpleBlockAddControllerSubscriber, on KernelEvents::VIEW for route layout_builder.choose_block) injects a 'Create simple block' link to route simple_block_layout_builder.edit_block. It sets a 'layout_builder' form handler EditSimpleBlockInLayoutBuilderForm on the simple_block entity, and hook_contextual_links_alter rewrites a placed simple block's Configure link. Simple blocks are placed as Layout Builder SectionComponents with plugin id simple_block:<id>. Depends layout_builder + simple_block. Medium cases introspect the form handler + route; hard cases place a simple block into a namespaced content type's (sblb_*) Layout-Builder layout and verify the section component.

evals.prompt: What does the simple_block_layout_builder submodule add to the Layout Builder experience, and on which controller/route does it hook to do it?
evals.expected_output: It adds a 'Create simple block' link to Layout Builder's Add block screen. An event subscriber (SimpleBlockAddControllerSubscriber) listens to KernelEvents::VIEW on the layout_builder.choose_block route and injects the link (to route simple_block_layout_builder.edit_block).

evals.prompt: In simple_block_layout_builder, what form is used to create/edit a simple block inside Layout Builder, and how does editing an already-placed simple block reach it?
evals.expected_output: It sets a 'layout_builder' form handler on the simple_block entity (EditSimpleBlockInLayoutBuilderForm) served at route simple_block_layout_builder.edit_block. hook_contextual_links_alter rewrites a placed simple block's Configure contextual link to open that form.

evals.prompt: When I place a simple block via Layout Builder, what block plugin id ends up in the section, and is the block deleted when I remove it from the layout?
evals.expected_output: It is placed as a Layout Builder section component with plugin id simple_block:<id>. Simple blocks created through Layout Builder are NOT automatically deleted when removed from a layout.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, simple_block_layout_builder is enabled. Inspect the simple_block entity type definition and give the class name of its 'layout_builder' form handler.
evals.expected_output: The 'layout_builder' form handler for the simple_block entity is Drupal\simple_block_layout_builder\Form\EditSimpleBlockInLayoutBuilderForm (set by simple_block_layout_builder_entity_type_alter).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which route does simple_block_layout_builder register for creating/editing a simple block inside Layout Builder, and what is its path? Inspect the live routing to answer.
evals.expected_output: Route simple_block_layout_builder.edit_block, path /layout_builder/simple-block/{section_storage_type}/{section_storage}/{delta}/{region}/{uuid}/{simple_block}, using the entity form simple_block.layout_builder.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type 'sblb_h1' uses Layout Builder. Create a simple block with id sblb_a and place it into sblb_h1's default layout (so it renders as a component). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create SimpleBlock sblb_a, then append a SectionComponent with configuration id 'simple_block:sblb_a' to a section of the node.sblb_h1.default Layout Builder display and save. Verify checks the sblb_a entity exists and a section component with plugin id simple_block:sblb_a is present.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type 'sblb_h2' uses Layout Builder. Create a simple block sblb_b and add it to sblb_h2's default layout. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create SimpleBlock sblb_b and append a SectionComponent with id 'simple_block:sblb_b' to the node.sblb_h2.default Layout Builder display, then save. Verify checks the sblb_b entity exists and a section component with plugin id simple_block:sblb_b is present.
